title: Nissan Canada newsroom: 2026 Nissan LEAF press kit
notes: Canada 2026: 7.2 kW onboard charger on S+, SV+, PLATINUM+; NACS standard; battery heater standard, release says the driver "can engage the heater to warm the battery before charging in cold weather" (manual); Google Maps charging-stop planner only on the 14.3-inch-screen grades (SV+, PLATINUM+); S+ has no Google built-in.
